title: Use a lexicon entry
subtitle: Move from an inflected form to a context-fitting sense.
overview: A lexicon entry begins with a lexical form, then offers a semantic range and examples. Find the form in the text before choosing an English gloss.
Record the construction and immediate context alongside the sense you select; a bare word list is not enough evidence.

sections.title: Lexicon note
rows: aorist form; know, come to know

items.grc: ὅσοι δὲ ἔλαβον αὐτόν, ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν.
items.en: But as many as received him, he gave them authority.
We know that we have come to know him.
